query: UPDATE mcp_connections SET kind = $3, issuer = $4, header_name = $5, ciphertext = $6, nonce = $7, wrapped_key = $8, key_id = $9, last4 = $10, expires_at = $11, account_label = $12, auth_error = NULL, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE server_id = $1 AND user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $2 RETURNING id
